fee_notes: Royalty Fee is the greater of 6% of weekly Gross Sales or $400/week minimum (traditional locations); non-traditional locations pay 6% with no minimum. Minimum weekly royalty of $400 converts to approximately $1,600/month. A Surcharge of up to $10/week may be added for franchisees in states with additional reporting requirements (currently only New York). Advertising Fee is currently 1% of weekly Gross Sales (up to 4% maximum). Data Fees up to $75/month for POS data polling. POS Help Desk/Maintenance Contract Fee is $55/month. In the event of breach/default, Royalties may be increased to up to 18% of Gross Sales or 3x the fixed Royalty Fee for a minimum 14-day period.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fee and Surcharge (Notes 1 and 9): Royalty Fee is the greater of the following: (i) 6% of total weekly Gross Sales or (ii) $400 per week. Surcharge is a maximum of $10 per week in addition to the Royalty Fee.

Advertising Fees (Note 1): Up to 4% of weekly Gross Sales. Currently, Advertising Fee is 1% of weekly Gross Sales, which goes to the Advertising Fund (Note 4).

Data Fees (Notes 1 and 6): Up to $75 per month (Subject to reasonable annual and/or service enhancement increases).

POS Help Desk Phone Support Maintenance Contract Fee: $55 per month.

Note 2: For traditional Great Steak restaurants, the Royalty Fee will be the greater of: (i) 6% of the total weekly Gross Sales or (ii) $400 per week. For non-traditional Great Steak restaurants, the Royalty Fee is 6% of total weekly Gross Sales with no minimum royalty.
